svg.title: Say it. Watch AI draw it. - Singularity at Nerd Fest 2026
svg.desc: Poster for the Singularity AI Club stall at Nerd Fest 2026: Friday 30 October, 3:00 to 6:30pm, The Pā, University of Waikato, Hamilton. Free entry.
svg.text: Talk to an AI agent and watch it type the prompt
and draw your picture, live on the big screen.
The Pā, University of Waikato, Hamilton · Free entry
Vote for your favourite picture online. Winners at 6pm.
